data.one_liner: Easy and fast Flutter internationalization with JSON/CSV/… loaders
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to load translation files from assets or custom loaders, supports plural, gender, nesting, RTL and fallback locales, and offers extension methods on Text and BuildContext.
use_when: You need a quick, zero‑boilerplate solution for localizing a Flutter app
You want to load translations from JSON, CSV, Yaml, or XML files
You need runtime locale switching with persistence
You want code generation for translation keys
avoid_when: You already use a full‑featured i18n framework like intl or slang
You need advanced features like message formatting with ICU or custom plural rules beyond what intl offers
You want to avoid adding an assets folder to your project
strengths: Supports multiple file formats via custom loaders
weaknesses: Requires assets folder and iOS plist configuration
Limited to Flutter (no pure Dart support)
Not as feature‑rich as intl for complex formatting
data.setup_notes: Add easy_localization to pubspec, declare assets folder, call EasyLocalization.ensureInitialized(), wrap app with EasyLocalization widget
